topics.body:
# Screenshot

Two captures, both to the clipboard, neither needing a click.

- `:screenshot screen` - every display
- `:screenshot window` - the focused window

Apple's `screencapture` does the work and writes straight to the clipboard, so no image data passes through Flash and the captures do not depend on the macOS Screenshot shortcuts being enabled or unchanged. It does need Flash to hold Screen Recording in System Settings > Privacy & Security; macOS asks the first time, and until it is granted both captures fail with `could not create image from display`.

The window capture names the focused window by its WindowServer id, which is why it never opens a picker.

Direct CLI verbs: `flash screenshot_screen` and `flash screenshot_window`. For mappings, use the plugin-command form, e.g. `["flash", "plugin_command", "--command=screenshot", "--subcommand=window"]`.
